Camera Simulator

This simulator places a virtual BirdDog P240 at the FMP catwalk position. Nothing connects to a real camera or controller.

If the simulator does not load, reload the page. That usually fixes it, for example just after an update.

It needs JavaScript and WebGL to draw the camera picture and run the controls. Without them, use the Catwalk PTZ operating guide.
